subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should browser routes temporarily fail stale for extension-relay and Chrome MCP after an operation, or must their owner-specific continuity behavior be implemented before removing the existing recovery path?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes behavior for two backend owners without proving that their volatile/raw target IDs remain valid after renderer replacement; choosing between fail-stale and continuity preservation is a product and compatibility contract decision.

options.title: Preserve owner continuity before merge
options.body: Keep or replace the relay/MCP recovery only with owner-provided stable handles or operation outcomes and regression proof for their public routes.

options.title: Accept explicit fail-stale behavior
options.body: Merge the Playwright-only correction while documenting that relay and MCP users must reselect after a target replacement until follow-up owner work lands.

options.title: Split the managed Playwright fix
options.body: Land only the managed Playwright path if it can be isolated without changing relay or MCP route behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner continuity before merge
recommendation.body: Keep or replace the relay/MCP recovery only with owner-provided stable handles or operation outcomes and regression proof for their public routes.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked current browser issue defines the required cross-backend identity contract and explicitly identifies the unresolved owner boundaries.
